subject: french
title: The Subjunctive Mood
welcome_lead: Mastery of the subjunctive marks HL writing. It expresses doubt, emotion, necessity, and possibility.
meta_desc: French grammar: subjunctive mood for HL writing.
final_note: The subjunctive is the mood of hope and doubt — handle it carefully.

concepts.def: Subjunctive mood — expresses doubt, wish, emotion.
That I be — present subjunctive of etre.
That I have — present subjunctive of avoir.
It is necessary that — triggers subjunctive.

walkthroughs.body_html: For regular verbs, take the 3rd person plural present (ils parlent) and add endings: que je parle, que tu parles, qu'il parle, que nous parlions, que vous parliez, qu'ils parlent.
Il faut que, je veux que, bien que, pour que, avant que, sans que, a moins que. Memorise these — they are the keys.
Il faut que tu fasses tes devoirs. Bien qu'il pleuve, nous sortons. Je veux que vous soyez heureux.
